## Main concepts

| Term         | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Form         | An Excel workbook used to collect data.                                      |
| Form model   | A versioned definition of a form’s sheets, fields, layout and constraints.   |
| Consumer     | A package, tool or application that uses the package’s operations.           |

## Form operations

| Term              | Meaning                                                                           |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Input form        | The populated form supplied to a workbook operation.                              |
| Root sheet        | The sheet whose records determine the output forms.                               |
| Root record       | A record selected by its complete primary key in the root sheet.                  |
| Related record    | A record connected to a selected parent record through a declared parent key.     |
| Shared sheet      | A table explicitly copied in full into every output form.                         |
| Output form       | An Excel form produced by the operation.                                          |
| Output manifest   | The returned mapping of output paths, source rows and root key values.            |
